entries.reason: CopyParty's upstream NixOS module defines a conflicting UMask; the NAS share-group write policy requires 0007.
The upstream Telegraf unit grants CAP_NET_RAW for the ping input; this configuration has no ping input and explicitly removes the unused ambient capability.
NixOS 26.05 sets nixpkgs.config read-only for allowUnfree; host-platform must force the GPU allowlist predicate.
NixOS 26.05 sets nixpkgs.config read-only; host-platform must force cudaSupport based on nas.hardware.llamaCpp.backend.
NixOS 26.05 sets nixpkgs.config read-only; host-platform must force rocmSupport based on nas.hardware.llamaCpp.backend.
The NixOS Caddy module bakes a static configFile; the bootstrap/full transition is a runtime decision, so the unit must force a /run-selected active config path.
Reload must re-read the /run-selected active config so Caddy follows the bootstrap-to-full secret activation without restarting the unit.
CopyParty data lives on the ZFS tank behind /var/lib/copyparty; reset the upstream StateDirectory directive so systemd does not replace or follow that runtime symlink.
